title: תל עזקה — עיכוב
brief: כחול: תוקף את תל עזקה מדרום. אדום: מחזיק בתל ומעכב את התקיפה. לפני הקרב כל צד מתכנן את משימתו.

window.place: Tel Azeka over the Elah valley (תל עזקה, עמק האלה): the tel stands at 345 m in the middle of the window, its eastern face falling 110 m to the valley floor, a ridge running south from it and low ground in the east.

about: A delay on Tel Azeka (decision 109, the author, 2026-10-21): the scenario for
telling whether breaking contact pays where holding loses. One RED squad of
telAzekaAssault's platoon, dug in where it stood there (RED-A-2), against one
BLUE platoon of that battle (BLUE-2: three squads, two machine gun teams, its
headquarters), from where it stood. No indirect fire, no charges. RED's
mission is a delay: not beaten by the end of turn 15, it has achieved it,
⚠️ Ours: the cut-down forces, and turn 15, which is also the attack's deadline
(telAzekaAssault's battles run a median of 12-13 turns).
